definitions.original_linked: Exact sourceId/name/image URL and PNG SHA verified against the current item detail data, or an existing manually reviewed L1J pair. This is image identity, not a new redistribution licence.
definitions.original_review_pending: Image displays, but identity evidence is incomplete; excluded from confirmed original count.
definitions.self_authored_substitute: Explicit TWILIGHT family symbol or existing owned UI icon; not original art.
definitions.image_missing: No displayable texture; never counted as linked.
